scope: Separate literary analysis of Tristram Shandy: chronology, autobiography, print effects, hobby-horses, sympathy, gender, philosophical parody and later reception.
editorial_boundary: Interpretations are attributed as interpretations. Textual materiality, stage of eighteenth-century fiction and nonchronology are not framed as anachronistic twentieth-century authorial intentions.
